text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Phew, huff...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu... That is true.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Stay calm, stay magnanimous... Even as I 
tell myself that, I can feel my spirits 
surging.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Because the Arima Kinen is right before 
our eyes.

In the recently announced fan vote 
results, Grass Wonder successfully earned 
her spot to run in the Arima Kinen.

Naturally, Maruzensky's name was also 
among the runners—

At last, the decisive battle against the 
"Monster," Maruzensky, is about to begin.
...Or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Withdrawing from the Arima Kinen...? 
Maruzensky-san is...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Yes... The cause was apparently an injury 
sustained during training.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, it seems Maruzensky-san 
was planning to move on to the Dream 
Trophy League after the Arima.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean competing against you in 
the Twinkle Series from now on is...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm afraid it will become 
difficult...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, what a shame...! Everyone was so 
hyped up, saying the next Arima Kinen 
would be the clash of "The Monster" and 
"The Monster II"...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I was all fired up to write the best 
article of my life too, but... *sigh*.

Today, we were scheduled to have an 
in-depth discussion on strategies against 
Maruzensky. But—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...It won't come true, will it...

Just then... in a voice that was barely a 
whisper, Grass Wonder murmured something 
quietly.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“From ‘Monster II’ to a true ‘Monster.’ 
Stepping out from the shadow of that great 
predecessor.”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That... never, ever again...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Just... kidding.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to be feeling down, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Either way, the gates to the Arima will 
open. There's nothing else to do but train 
for it, right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That's why I—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, I'm heading out to run.

"Yet, despite my attempts to stop her, 
Grass Wonder dashed away into the 
distance."

Grass Wonder is a strong girl. Perhaps 
that's why she feels she can't even have a 
good cry in front of me.

I know that she probably needs some time 
alone as well, but...
choice_data_list:
(It's so frustrating not being able to do 
anything...!)

text_block_list.text: And right then—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Are Grass and the others here?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ……Oh, it's just you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hii... is not something I'm really in a 
position to casually say, is it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry about the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Both you and Grass-chan worked so hard 
preparing for this..."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly sorry that I won't be able to 
run. ...I just came to tell you that.

Injuries can happen by accident, so it's 
not something Maruzensky needs to 
apologize for.

"Even knowing that, whenever I think about 
Grass Wonder, feelings of frustration just 
boil over..."
choice_data_list:
So you have no intention of staying at 
Twinkle...?
You don't plan on staying at Twinkle...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Right, there isn't.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Moving on to the Dream Trophy League next 
year is something I decided on a long time 
ago anyway.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Besides—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey... the reason you want to hold me 
back, it's for Grass-chan's sake after 
all, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"You want me and Grass-chan to race. Don't 
you?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Still—that time surely isn't right now.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan and me. The time for us to 
settle things isn't now.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Watching the Japan Cup made me think so.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Anything beyond this is a secret.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you know... Grass-chan will be 
fine. ...She'll be fine."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Because that girl is—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"You've had soooo many of the things I 
could never reach, no matter how much I 
yearned for them, right from the very 
start!"
